title: compare_snapshots input

base_snapshot_id.description: The older snapshot, attached as a second sealed file (D03).

snapshot_id.description: The newer snapshot; default is the repository's current one.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.

description: What changed between two sealed snapshots of one repository: symbols added, removed and changed (matched by kind and qualified name), relationships added and removed by type, and files added, removed, changed or re-dispositioned. The base snapshot is attached as a second read-only file; the envelope's snapshot is the head.
